raw.details:
Softlink Global Pvt. Ltd. presents LogiTHON 2026, a groundbreaking 24-hour hackathon bringing together technology and logistics.

Hosted at Atharva University, Mumbai, LogiTHON 2026 aims to create a platform where innovation meets real-world logistics challenges. The event will bring together talented students, industry experts, and mentors to explore emerging technologies and develop innovative solutions for the logistics and supply chain industry.

LogiTHON 2026, scheduled for 12th and 13th December 2026, will bring together diverse participants to develop innovative solutions addressing key logistics challenges, with a focus on efficiency, sustainability, social impact, and mentorship.

LogiTHON aims to reshape the future of logistics by exploring supply chain optimization, last-mile delivery innovations, and technology-driven solutions, fostering a dynamic ecosystem of idea exchange and collaborative partnerships.

Guidelines

  • Duration: 24 hours of working on problem statements.

  • Eligibility: Open to all undergraduate and diploma students from any background with adequate knowledge of the domain and a valid student ID card.

  • Team Formation: Students must register in teams of 2 to 4 members. Each team must have a designated Team Leader and a unique Team Name.

General Rules

  • Selected teams must make their own travel arrangements for the final round according to the announced timeline. Food and accommodation will be provided at the venue.

  • Evaluation criteria will include originality, technical intricacy, feasibility, and projected impact.

  • Project submissions must include comprehensive documentation, links to code repositories, and a concise presentation.

  • Participants must carry their laptops and any other necessary components.

  • In case of any disputes or discrepancies, the organizers' decision will be final and binding.

  • Timelines may vary at different stages throughout the event.

  • Please refer to the official brochure for detailed information about the event and the problem statements.

Prize Pool: ₹3,00,000

  • Winner: ₹1,00,000 for each problem statement.

  • Runner-up: ₹50,000 for each problem statement.

Venue

Atharva University, Mumbai, India

Event Dates: 12th–13th December 2026

Organized by: Softlink Global Ltd.
